Marta Ironbrew.style: A broad, sharp-eyed halfling innkeeper in her fifties. Warm, brisk and funny, with a no-nonsense edge when her furniture is at risk.

Bruno.style: A huge, calm bouncer. Slow, deep and patient, like a man who hates raising his voice and always wins anyway.

Gruk Tannerson.style: A loud, scarred sellsword three drinks in. Boastful and gravelly, quick to take offence, laughing at his own jokes.

Dagger Dan.style: A grinning, sly hanger-on. Quick, smug and sneering, always backing his boss.

Skinny Jo.style: A nervous, eager hanger-on. High, quick and jumpy, laughing too soon.

Odo Pennywhistle.style: A cheerful, slightly drunk regular. Warm and rambling, delighted by gossip.

Pell Brightwater.style: A cheerful, slightly drunk regular. Friendly and slurry, ready to throw a mug for the fun of it.

Nim.style: A thin, nervous spy in a gray cloak. Quiet, hurried and wary, glancing at the door between phrases.
